H * 0.055 : H * 0.03; var id = 'tick' + i; paths.push({ id: id, commands: visualSdk.polyline([[x, y - h], [x, y + h]]) }); children.push({ type: 'path', pathId: id, stroke: '#26354a', strokeWidth: (i === 0 || i === n) ? 2 : 1.5 }); } children.push({ type: 'label', text: '比例尺 1:10000', x: W / 2, y: H * 0.16, fontSize: fs, anchor: 'middle', fill: '#26354a' }); children.push({ type: 'label', text: '0', x: left, y: y + H * 0.10, fontSize: small, anchor: 'middle', fill: '#26354a' }); children.push({ type: 'label', text: '7 厘米', x: right, y: y + H * 0.10, fontSize: small, anchor: 'middle', fill: '#26354a' }); children.push({ type: 'label', text: '图上距离 7 厘米', x: W / 2, y: y + H * 0.20, fontSize: fs, anchor: 'middle', fill: '#26354a' }); children.push({ type: 'label', text: '实际距离 70000 厘米', x: W / 2, y: y + H * 0.31, fontSize: fs, anchor: 'middle', fill: '#26354a' }); return { schemaVersion: 1, sceneId: 'scale-line-1-10000', revision: input.revision, viewBox: { x: 0, y: 0, width: W, height: H }, paths: paths, root: { type: 'group', children: children } }; } };
